prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Spectrum 1-4: page #F9F9FB, text #251F2D, accent #861D85, secondary surface #EFEAE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Composition: Three-column product grid, consistent image ratios, filter rail, one-column mobile. Use body 18px, heading 36px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
